scope: Three-file guidance-only draft; no runtime, dependency, version or release-authority change

checks.testCaveat: One unavailable-native unit case returns early when native peer is installed. Real native training tests executed. Fresh peer-absent consumers separately exercised rejection/fallback; do not describe the unit suite alone as all-branches or zero-skip native coverage.
checks.freshConsumers: Both baseline and candidate imported exports; selected expected k-NN winners; trained KRR, serialized, exited and restored in a new process; tested missing-native fallback/errors; separately installed pinned native peer, trained a real safetensors model, exited and loaded/routed in a new process.
checks.nativeScope: Five-dimensional synthetic fixture; native train/restart/route functionality, not model quality improvement or arbitrary-dimensional compatibility

rollback.method: Applied staged three-file patch in independent clean worktree, checked candidate tree, reversed patch with --index, checked exact baseline tree and clean git status
rollback.limits: Source rollback only; no npm publication occurred and no external effects to undo
